subject: BrightMarket: hosted API usage top-up and rate-band adjustment
messages:
From: Jessica Liu <jessica@brightmarket.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@brightmarket.com
Date: 2026-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Question: can we increase hosted commit mid-term?

Hi Olga,

Hope you're well — we've been ramping faster than anticipated and are seeing sustained higher token usage across our personalization endpoints. We have 5 months left on our current hosted commit and would like to discuss increasing the monthly commit and adjusting rate limits for burst windows.

Key asks:
- Add +30% monthly token commit starting next billing cycle
- Raise per-minute rate limit for our production key to support spikes (we have predictable daily peaks)
- Pricing impact and any early renewal credit you can offer

Looping in procurement so they can flag PO steps. We tried the self-serve change but ran into the rate-band guardrail. Can Ben or someone send a formal proposal we can circulate internally?

Thanks,
Jessica
Director of Product
BrightMarket
[Attachment: usage_snapshot_July2026.csv (CSV, 18KB)]

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Jessica Liu <jessica@brightmarket.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, procurement@brightmarket.com
Date: 2026-08-18T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question: can we increase hosted commit mid-term?

Hi Jessica — thanks for the details and the usage snapshot, that helps a lot. I'm copying Ben (AE) and Hannah (RevOps) to draft a proposal with options. At a high level we can do either:

Option A — Interim top-up (short term):
- +30% monthly commit for remainder of term
- No contract extension, pro-rated billing for added commit this quarter
- Temporary bump in the regional rate limit to 1.5x current production cap with automatic rollback if sustained for >14 days

Option B — Early renewal + uplift (preferred for unit economics):
- Commit increase to +30% and extend term by 12 months
- Volume discount tier applied (5–10% depending on ARR uplift)
- Higher sustained rate-band and priority capacity during bursts

Ben will follow with numbers and a draft PDF proposal you can share with procurement. Hannah — can you confirm PO/invoice cadence and whether Finance will accept a pro-rated invoice for the interim top-up?

- Olga
Olga Petrov
Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[phone: (415) 555-0142]

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Jessica Liu <jessica@brightmarket.com>, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, procurement@brightmarket.com
Date: 2026-08-19T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question: can we increase hosted commit mid-term? — proposal attached

Jessica — attached is a concise proposal with two concrete paths, pricing, and operational details. Highlights:

- Interim Top-up (3–4 month window): +30% monthly token commit, pro-rated at $0.018/token equivalent (matches current tier), one-time admin fee waived. Rate-band: temporary burst cap to 1.5x production qps; throttling strategy unchanged.

- Early Renewal & Uplift (12 months): +30% baseline commit, 8% volume discount, prioritized capacity (pre-emptive slots during region burst windows), inclusion in our dedicated throughput lane for queued bursts above baseline.

Operational notes:
- We will provision the rate-band change via a routing policy tied to your org id; bursts above 1.5x will hit graceful degradation to a fallback model if configured.
- We require a signed addendum for immediate top-ups, or a standard renewal SOW for the 12-mo path.

Attachments in this message: BrightMarket_commit_proposal_20260901.pdf (proposal, includes line-item pricing and sample invoice schedule).

Let me know which direction you prefer and I'll prepare the addendum/SOW + DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Strategic Customers
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: BrightMarket_commit_proposal_20260901.pdf (PDF, 84KB)]

From: procurement@brightmarket.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Michael Hart <michael.hart@brightmarket.com>, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-24T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal — procurement questions and PO info

Hi Ben / Olga,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement has a few clarifying items before we can route for signature:
1) Can you confirm billing cadence (monthly invoice vs. quarterly) and whether you accept net-30?
2) We prefer the early renewal path but need the 12-month price lock in writing.
3) Please provide a standard PO template you can accept and the remit address for invoicing.

Also, the security team asks whether the burst bump requires any additional VPC peering changes or IAM keys to be rotated. If not, we can proceed faster.

Regards,
BrightMarket Procurement
procurement@brightmarket.com
[Attachment: BM_PO_Request_Form.pdf (PDF, 12KB)]

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: procurement@brightmarket.com, ben_carter@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-25T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal — procurement questions and PO info

Hi — quick answers from Finance/RevOps: 
- Billing: we can invoice monthly or quarterly. Net-30 is fine; we can also support net-45 if required by internal policies but that needs approval.
- Price lock: the renewal SOW will include a 12-month fixed rate for the committed units. The addendum for the interim top-up will be pro-rated and not price-locking beyond the quoted pro-rate.
- PO: we can accept a standard PO; please use the remit address on the attached invoice stub. I attached a short template we've used for prior deals.

Security note: the burst bump is a routing/policy change only; no VPC networking or credential rotation is required for the standard hosted path. If BrightMarket uses a customer-managed VPC or Private deployment, we'd need a short maintenance window, but it doesn't sound like that's the case.

- Hannah Schmitt
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_PO_Acceptance_Template.pdf (PDF, 7KB)]

From: Jessica Liu <jessica@brightmarket.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@brightmarket.com, Michael Hart <michael.hart@brightmarket.com>, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-01T14:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal — procurement questions and PO info

Thanks everyone — we reviewed internally and we want to move forward with the Early Renewal & Uplift (12 months).

Next steps from our side: procurement will raise the PO this week and Michael will sign the SOW once DocuSign is routed. We appreciate the price lock and the priority capacity guarantees. Please send the SOW + DocuSign link and a short checklist of any info you need from our security team (they confirmed no infra changes required).

—Jessica
Jessica Liu
Director of Product, BrightMarket
